input.sql:
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price * Amount) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
